description: This file defines the AesEncryptingStream class, which implements an encrypted data stream using AES encryption, including methods for encryption, seeking, and size calculation.

classes.name: AesEncryptingStream
classes.description: Implements an AES encryption stream with methods for reading, seeking, and size calculation, utilizing a cipher method and stream interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the stream with a plaintext stream, encryption key, and cipher method.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns the OpenSSL cipher name used for encryption.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the size of the encrypted data, considering padding.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream is not writable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads encrypted data of specified length from the stream.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream, adjusting buffer and cipher position.

methods.name: encryptBlock
methods.description: Encrypts a block of plaintext data using OpenSSL and updates cipher state.
